links.outcome: Patient comprehension of the tool's outputs (percentiles, line graphs, jargon)
links.effect: Most patients understood the tool's take-home message, but some patients and clinicians felt percentiles, line graphs, and medical jargon decreased clarity and comprehension.
links.quote: some patients and clinicians felt the use of percentiles, line graphs, and medical jargon decreased patients' clarity and comprehension of the tool

screen.reason: Qualitative evaluation of patient and clinician perceptions of a personalized 'people-like-me' predictive decision support tool deployed in two outpatient physical therapy clinics.
